_comment: Opt-in fragment merged when manifest.hooks.multi_session.enabled is true. The multi-session registry baseline (session-register.sh on SessionStart + session-deregister.sh on SessionEnd, with reconcile-sessions.sh reaping stale/closed-pending peers) is already wired in the default templates/settings.json. This fragment is the redundant belt-and-suspenders multi-session config: it wires the unwired diagnostic session-start-canary.sh into SessionStart for adopters who want the SessionStart legacy-plans-dir tripwire active by default (the canary ships runtime/internal and is NOT default-wired). The installer deep-merges this fragment's entries into the SessionStart hooks array of the user's settings.json. NOT merged into the default settings.json — opt-in only.
